modules.title: Start Here
modules.description: Course orientation, instructor introduction, and getting started.

modules.title: Unit 1: Socrates and Plato
modules.description: Explore the life and philosophy of Socrates and Plato through the Euthyphro, Apology, and Crito.

modules.title: Unit 2: Rene Descartes
modules.description: Examine Descartes' method of doubt and the foundations of modern philosophy.

modules.title: Unit 3: David Hume
modules.description: Investigate Hume's empiricism, skepticism about causation, and the limits of reason.

modules.title: Unit 4: G. W. F. Hegel
modules.description: Understand Hegel's dialectic, philosophy of history, and vision of freedom.

modules.title: Unit 5: Karl Marx
modules.description: Analyze Marx's historical materialism, class struggle, and critique of capitalism.

modules.title: Unit 6: Jean-Paul Sartre
modules.description: Explore Sartre's existentialism, radical freedom, and ethics of responsibility.

modules.title: Final Exam
modules.description: Comprehensive final exam covering all course units.
